title: Build a custom Zoho CRM widget in 20 lines of code #Shorts

angle.problem: Users need a custom screen inside CRM that Zoho doesn't natively provide, like a live calculator or map.
angle.solution: Build and embed a custom CRM Widget using HTML, JavaScript, and the Zoho Embedded App SDK.
steps: Create an extension in Zoho Developer Console and set up a Hosted Widget widget project.
Initialize the SDK in your JS file using ZOHO.embeddedApp.init() and fetch record data with ZOHO.CRM.API.getRecord().
Deploy the widget and place it directly into a CRM module's Related List or Custom Button.
angle.result: Bring any external UI, calculator, or dashboard directly inside your Zoho CRM interface.
angle.wow: You can embed custom web apps inside Zoho CRM tabs that interact live with CRM data records.
angle.hook: Need a screen Zoho doesn't have? Build a CRM widget in 20 lines of code.
